content.short: Orb is a decentralized professional networking app for Web3 that runs on the Polygon chain.
content.description: Orb is a decentralized professional networking app for Web3 that runs on the Polygon chain, using an end-to-end on-chain credibility system and the Lens protocol. Orb connects people, companies, and projects within Web3 and serves as a professional social network for Web3 working professionals. It includes features like quizzes that reward NFTs for completion.
